title.en: Query the Valid Reading Count by Area

brief.zh: 用 SQL 生成每个区域的记录数，供站长核对。
brief.en: Use SQL to count valid readings for each area so the manager can check coverage.

concept.zh: GROUP BY zone 产生每区一行，COUNT(reading) 统计组内有读数的行。
concept.en: GROUP BY zone returns one row per area, and COUNT(reading) counts rows with a reading in each group.

hints.zh: 先让所有分组都显示出来。样本最多的区域有 4 条。
hints.en: Keep all groups visible. The largest groups have four readings.

prompt.zh: 输出全部三个区域的有效记录数，按区域键排序。
prompt.en: Return valid reading counts for all three areas, sorted by area key.
